unlabeled.title: Antithrombotic monotherapy after DAPT
knowledge_gaps: Uncertainty about optimal antithrombotic monotherapy in ACS patients who have undergone PCI.
Need for head-to-head comparison based on superiority between aspirin monotherapy and clopidogrel monotherapy after stopping DAPT.
recommended_research: RCTs evaluating the benefit–risk balance for ischaemic and bleeding events for different durations of antithrombotic therapy.
A head-to-head randomized superiority trial comparing aspirin versus clopidogrel monotherapy after DAPT.

7.title: Acute coronary syndrome with unstable presentation
knowledge_gaps: The role of percutaneous mechanical circulatory support (MCS) devices in patients presenting with ACS and cardiogenic shock (CS) remains unclear.
recommended_research: Randomized comparisons between standard of care and percutaneous MCS devices in ACS with CS.

8.title: Management of acute coronary syndrome during hospitalization
knowledge_gaps: Whether clinical improvement can be achieved through the use of risk stratification based on validated risk prediction models.
recommended_research: Randomized trials with patients assigned to a particular intervention versus usual care guided by validated risk prediction models to assess clinical benefit.

9.title: Technical aspects of invasive strategies
knowledge_gaps: Does intravascular imaging–guided revascularization strategy improve clinical outcomes in patients with ACS?

Does intracoronary physiology assessment of myocardial reperfusion after primary PCI (PPCI) improve risk stratification and enable stratified therapies to limit microvascular dysfunction/reperfusion injury and microvascular obstruction (MVO) post-ACS?
In ACS patients with an infarct-related artery (IRA) that is unsuitable for stent implantation, does drug-coated balloon treatment of the IRA improve clinical outcomes?
recommended_research: RCTs evaluating the efficacy of an intravascular imaging–guided revascularization strategy to improve meaningful clinical outcomes in patients with ACS.
Prospective evaluation of whether intracoronary physiology assessment of myocardial reperfusion better stratifies patient risk.
Randomized trials in patients with an IRA unsuitable for stent implantation comparing drug-coated balloon treatment versus usual care to evaluate clinical outcomes.
